About Me

I'm a Data Analytics fresher who enjoys finding patterns, solving problems, and turning data into clear insights. I started exploring web development but discovered that I enjoyed working with data, analysis, dashboards and business insights much more. Since then, I've been building practical projects using SQL, Excel, Power BI and Python.

My current focus is strengthening my SQL, Power BI, Excel and analytical problem-solving skills while building projects that demonstrate how I approach real-world data problems.
